root_cause: Frozen metadata incorrectly recorded ENTRYPOINT=[python3], CMD=null. Actual read-only inspect output was Entrypoint=null, Cmd=[python3]. Without an explicit --entrypoint override, Docker replaced the default Cmd with /work/candidate.py and attempted direct OS execution of a Python source file without a shebang.
retry: No retry under this identity. Correct invocation is a new version with explicit --entrypoint python3 and fresh frozen artifacts.
